_comment: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — consumed by bench/failure_modes.py to attribute a MISSED planted error to the architectural layer that dropped the signal. This file does NOT affect recall/FP/trap scoring (that is eval/run_eval.py + bench/scorer.py); it only explains WHY a miss happened, so it cannot overfit the detector. Field meanings: requires_all = expected-assertion ids (from expected_greyharbor_s1.json) that must be extracted + resolved + correct for the check to even be able to fire. requires_prior_any = for premature_knowledge, the earlier knower(s); if none survive, the asymmetry is structurally undetectable (an extraction miss on the source side). violation_keyword = for capability_violation, the positive act that must be extracted to conflict with the 'cannot' rule. presence_dependent = the check needs the entity in scene_presence at the violating scene (objects/locations are only present via the scene slug today). downstream = the layer to attribute when ALL required data IS present and correct yet the check still did not fire.
